_comment: Adventure boards extracted from PikminCardReference.xlsx by tools/extract_adventure.py. Home-anchored: treasure at the far end (idx 6), home near (idx 0). Per board: lanes, placedStructures/placedEnemies (bosses on treasure spaces), treasures[] (from Campaign Maps Z-AC, placed on treasure spaces), enemyDeck[] (Campaign N Enemies), gatherDeck[] (shared 12 campaign cards), eventDeck[] (Campaign Event Cards, by board position; drawn one/turn). unmapped[] = overlay text with no game id yet.
